mapper.select: SELECT d.cd_grp_id AS grp,d.dtl_cd AS code,d.cd_nm AS name FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g USING(cd_grp_id) WHERE d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y' AND d.cd_grp_id IN ('EMP_TYPE','POSITION','WORK_TYPE','GRADE','JOB','SKILL','WORK_STATUS') ORDER BY d.cd_grp_id,d.sort_seq,d.dtl_cd

SELECT m.trns_cd_grp_id AS grp,m.excel_lbl_nm AS label,m.trns_cd AS code FROM cmn.excel_map m JOIN cmn.cd_dtl d ON d.cd_grp_id=m.trns_cd_grp_id AND d.dtl_cd=m.trns_cd JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=d.cd_grp_id WHERE m.use_yn='Y' AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y'
SELECT ptnr_id,ptnr_nm FROM mst.ptnr WHERE use_yn='Y' AND ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH') AND (ptnr_nm=#{label} OR replace(biz_reg_no,'-','')=replace(#{label},'-','')) ORDER BY ptnr_id
SELECT bsn_part_id FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE use_yn='Y' AND bsn_part_nm=#{name}

SELECT d.dev_id,d.dev_nm,d.emp_se_cd,d.duty_se_cd,d.pstn_cd,d.bsn_part_id,d.use_yn,d.rsgn_dt,coalesce(p.ptnr_nm,'자사') AS affiliation FROM mst.dev d LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr p ON p.ptnr_id=d.vndr_ptnr_id WHERE d.mng_no=#{number}
SELECT d.attr1_val FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g USING(cd_grp_id) WHERE d.cd_grp_id='POSITION' AND d.dtl_cd=#{position} AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y'
SELECT cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT count(*) FROM cst.mth_cst WHERE cst_ym=#{month}
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN emp_se_cd IN ('FT','CT') THEN slry_amt+alwnc_amt+sins_cmpny_amt+rtrpay_acml_amt ELSE slry_amt END AS indv_lbr_cst_amt, CASE WHEN emp_se_cd='OS' THEN slry_amt+vat_amt ELSE slry_amt+alwnc_amt-sins_emp_amt-whtax_amt-ern_tax_amt END AS real_pay_amt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM (VALUES(CAST(#{emp_se_cd} AS text),CAST(#{slry_amt} AS bigint),CAST(#{alwnc_amt} AS bigint),CAST(#{sins_cmpny_amt} AS bigint),CAST(#{rtrpay_acml_amt} AS bigint),CAST(#{vat_amt} AS bigint),CAST(#{sins_emp_amt} AS bigint),CAST(#{whtax_amt} AS bigint),CAST(#{ern_tax_amt} AS bigint))) AS v(emp_se_cd,slry_amt,alwnc_amt,sins_cmpny_amt,rtrpay_acml_amt,vat_amt,sins_emp_amt,whtax_amt,ern_tax_amt)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cst.drct_expns e USING sys.upld u WHERE e.upld_id=u.upld_id AND u.form_cd='B.1' AND e.expns_ym=#{month} AND e.prj_id IS NULL AND e.expns_item_cd IN ('TEAM','PEXP')
mapper.update: UPDATE cst.mth_cst SET excel_diff_desc=#{description} WHERE mth_cst_id=#{id}
